accounting: FILLED -> SETTLED -> CASH_CONFIRMED -> REALIZED. SETTLED and CASH_CONFIRMED are kept separate and a settled outcome is never reported as realized.
label: GEMINI_BTC5M_UNDERDOG_COHORT1_AUDIT_V1
read_only: this audit imports no order path; it reads the contract object, positions/settled and our own durable ledger

CASH_CONFIRMED.label: REALIZED. The venue's own settled-position cashflow record, not a mark and not an outcome.
CASH_CONFIRMED.realized_net_basis: venue payout minus venue costBasis minus the venue's own charged fee

contractMetadata.description: If the price of Bitcoin (BTC) is greater than or equal to the price specified in the title on October 5, 2026 at 1:30pm ET, this market will resolve to Yes. Otherwise, it will resolve to No. If no eligible trade occurs during the contract window, this contract will resolve based on the most recent traded price prior. Outcome verified against the LS-LRRR-XBTUSD index. View the [full rules](https://assets.gemini.com/predictions/terms_and_conditions/btc_398860b3-ea2f-47a7-b167-a8c6ad03d6d7.pdf).

counterfactual_down.label: COUNTERFACTUAL. No DOWN order was sent, so this is modelled, never realized, and its fee is the published schedule rather than a charged one.

DESCRIPTIVE.label: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, on five probe-contaminated windows. It selects no strategy and no threshold.

FILLED.fill_record_source: venue order_history + mytrades, joined on order_id

SETTLED.label: SETTLED is the OUTCOME leg only. It is not cash and not realized.
SETTLED.payout_basis: $1 per share iff the contract resolved to the outcome leg WE hold; a NO holder is paid $0 by a `yes` resolution

strike_consistency.rule: UP resolves yes when settlementValue >= strike.value
